title: Rupee jumps 23 paise to 92.62 against US dollar during early trade
description:
The rupee jumped 23 paise to 92.62 against the US dollar in early trade on Wednesday, buoyed by strong foreign-fund inflows amid a buying rush in domestic equity markets and sliding overseas crude oil prices.
A strong American currency, however, capped gains in the local currency, forex traders said.
In the interbank foreign exchange market, the rupee opened at 92.65 and climbed to 92.62 against the greenback, up 23 paise from its previous close.
On Monday, the rupee declined from its seven-month high level to close with a loss of 23 paise at 92.85 against the US dollar.
The Indian currency market was closed on Tuesday on account of Prakash Gurpurb Sri Guru Nanak Dev.
The local unit logged a sharp gain of over 1.6 per cent in the preceding five back-to-back sessions since the closing level of 94.19 against the greenback recorded on November 13.
